summary: Shared SMTP helper hardcodes From:MB Pinet and EHLO pinet.lt for every niche, including the owner's independent Promedical mailbox. Pass the actual operator display name with validated headers and derive EHLO from the authenticated mailbox domain; preserve default MB Pinet behavior for existing callers.
rollback: Scoped revert of optional display-name/derived-EHLO integration; credentials and mail DNS are private operations outside this source repair.
